title: Compact Disc
description: Records from Herb's top songs pressed as compact discs. Tilt one and the 1.6 micron track pitch splits the light into a rainbow that streams out from the lamp's reflection, while the clear polycarbonate hub and outer lip show the table through. Tap it to turn it over to a printed label with the cover, a ring of colour pulled from the art and the tracklist set around the edge; flick it hard and the next record spins in.
intent: One optical object made believable: a radial diffraction grating with first to third orders and the track pitch of a real CD drives the colour, a mirror environment and a small hot lamp reflection give it contrast, the clear hub and lip show the table through, and the label side is printed from each cover in silver, gold or black stock.
